works.title: The Society of Tomorrow

author.name: Gustave de Molinari
author.biography: Belgian-born economist of the French liberal school, editor of the Journal des economistes for decades, and the first theorist to ask whether even security could be supplied by competition rather than monopoly.

works.description: Molinari's late forecast of a world ordered by free contract: the state of war giving way to the state of peace, written at the end of six decades of argument. The 1904 English edition, from the shelves of David Hart's Digital Library of Liberty and Power.
